essence: It breaks non-separation by showing it was never sameness: devotees and worldlings share one world but eat differently (1–4); cosmic lights shrink to droplets (5–6); seeing runs both directions at once (7); the pleased drag the world inside (8); all looks same-eyed but for the Uneven-eyed Seer (9); deniers depend on Him (10); the whole path conditional on standing (11); same wandering, different placement (12); mere conduct perfects (13); servants claim bearing (14); vision leaves touch hungry (15); ghee makes sorrows bearable (16); unreality permitted by omnipotence (17); qualities dance, breathed by Him (18); ego the prop of manifestation (19); anger-fire purifies (20); daylight accuses (21); all nectar, yet sole mortality-house (22); name-and-bow-mark empower (23); ease-by-identity demanded (24); slave-and-self, gods sated through him (25); eater-fire between heart and navel closes (26).

sections.SUMMARY: It breaks non-separation by showing it was never sameness: devotees and worldlings share one world but eat differently (1–4); cosmic lights shrink to droplets (5–6); seeing runs both directions at once (7); the pleased drag the world inside (8); all looks same-eyed but for the Uneven-eyed Seer (9); deniers depend on Him (10); the whole path conditional on standing (11); same wandering, different placement (12); mere conduct perfects (13); servants claim bearing (14); vision leaves touch hungry (15); ghee makes sorrows bearable (16); unreality permitted by omnipotence (17); qualities dance, breathed by Him (18); ego the prop of manifestation (19); anger-fire purifies (20); daylight accuses (21); all nectar, yet sole mortality-house (22); name-and-bow-mark empower (23); ease-by-identity demanded (24); slave-and-self, gods sated through him (25); eater-fire between heart and navel closes (26).
sections.FUNCTION: Discrimination-song: it sorts the shared world without leaving it — telling devotee from worldling, seeing from touching, being from Seer — so non-duality survives difference.
sections.KEY TERMS:
* **aviccheda-bhaṅga** — breaking of non-separation: the title's paradox; oneness broken open, not broken apart.
* **samadṛk / viṣamekṣaṇa** — the same-eyed world vs the Uneven-eyed Seer (v.9): the single asymmetry that saves difference.
* **ātmābhimāna** — self-pride (v.19): prop of manifestation, not fault; it's boldest theodicy.
* **sutkaṇṭha(?)** — GRETIL-marked crux (v.15): hunger kept uncertain on purpose; do not emend.
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Tenth song: sequel to the asking of Stotra 9. Where Stotra 9 asked, this one sorts — read the comfort-word after the long *kadā* stretch.
sections.EXPLANATION: It works by pairs that refuse to merge: slave/worldling (1–2), moment/all-time (4), drop/ocean (5), seen/seeing (7), outer/inner (8), same-eyed/Uneven-eyed (9), being/denial (10), ill-placed/well-placed (12), vision/touch (15), being/non-being (24), slave/self (25). Each pair is stated, never mediated; the breaking (*bhaṅga*) is the refusal to fuse what devotion holds together. Verses 16–20 domesticate the wild pairs (ghee, permission, breath-puppets, ego-prop, purifying anger); verses 21–22 turn the pairs on the self (daylight accusation, election paradox); verses 23–26 close with insignia, demand, double-identity, and fire.
sections.BOUNDARY: Verses 10.7 (reversible seeing), 10.15 (marked crux), 10.19 (ego-theodicy), and 10.22 (election paradox) are all reported per the argmap, never closed here. It explains nothing about HOW mere conduct perfects (v.13) — minimum means is asserted, not derived.
sections.RELATED:
* Stotra 12, v.10 (pretense suffices): the same minimum-means logic, softer.
* Stotra 2, v.24 (embracers over knowers): finding vs seeing, same split as v.15 here.
* Stotra 6 (effortlessness): v.13's conduct-alone belongs with it.
